title: LLMs 知道约束但不会使用：务实约束推理中的激活瓶颈
summary: 该研究探讨了LLMs在表面线索与隐含可行性约束冲突时的失败模式。通过条件约束激活框架，区分了知识、对称性、路由和修复，发现模型内部编码了约束但未能有效路由到决策中。激活修补可修复部分模型，提示干预无效。
summary_en: This research explores failure modes of LLMs when surface cues conflict with implicit feasibility constraints. Using a conditional constraint activation framework, it distinguishes knowledge, symmetry, routing, and repair, finding models encode constraints but fail to route them. Activation patching repairs some models; prompting interventions are ineffective.
